decisions.reason: Removing the copyright-page publication-attribution line does not change the cover visual, image count, or trim size.
The decision removes one manuscript line but does not change the requested guidance about publication prerequisites, front matter, or back matter.
The removed copyright-page line is unrelated to Chapter 18 heading hierarchy, capitalization, and punctuation.
Removing a copyright-page text line does not affect chapter-image distortion, cropping, artifacts, or pixelation.
The candidate state does not retain the publication-attribution line as an attribute; the line's removal is already owned by the dedicated copyright-attribution Requirement.
The source removes a copyright-page attribution line and does not cancel or alter the required back matter or author lines.
The attribution-line removal does not change the deferred guided KDP upload workflow or its listing-support terms.
The book remains a 6 x 9 inch paperback regardless of removal of the copyright-page attribution line.
The source removes only the publication-attribution line, not the copyright page or its center-alignment requirement.
Removing the copyright-page line does not change the deferred paragraph-spacing and body-density requirement.
The copyright-page text decision does not affect chapter-image coverage, placement, references, or full-page presentation.
The source does not state that removing the line changes pagination or the requirement to update table-of-contents page numbers after fixing the book size.
